author: Zeldagamelink
quote: Spoiler alert:Terrible game I've NEVER played anything this bad and let's set the record straight it's NOT original. The Game Awards kept saying only original games with broad appeal deserve GOTY that's how they justified Zelda tears of the kingdom losing in 2023. Players hyped botw over totk just like they did ocarina of time over majora mask same old pointless debates. A sequel isn't better just because it reuses "gameplay". That brings us to gta VI and this obsession with innovation as if it were law. Maybe for gta but not for resident evil. Resident evil 9 blends 1, 2 and 4 without trying to innovate despite what some claim and it's arguably one of the series' best. These arguments expose this fanatical, lying industry and the fraud that is gta vi. Gta vi has ZERO originality its formula doesn't age like fine wine you can't recycle it for 20 games yet that's what it offers: robbing, killing, dealing drugs but on top of that rockstar mocks supposedly "sensible" players with their slogans about the game's realism. So much so that players and the press have all agreed on the same line "the game that will revolutionize the video game industry" and when we talk strangely enough about the press's bizarre scores on metacritic namely 140 100/100 ratings we have every right to question the quality but nothing comes of it players justify themselves by saying that the game is "realistic" to defend the game's throne. Talking to these individuals would be about as useful as talking to a traffic cone. Getting back to gtavi and also to rockstar gta is a formula that has no future considering you could already do everything since gta4 a few mechanics have been added but without making it an ULTRA original game. needless to say that doing the same thing robbing, killing, dealing drugs and seeing half-naked characters doesn't make it an original game. THE only thing rockstar added to gta 6 is crossing the forbidden line of realistic gaming officially turning it into a pornographic game millions of unsuspecting people got their hands on the game to be "in" with everyone else but at what cost? A broken promise in exchange for a guarantee of quality? This game is devoid of mechanics it has no mechanics you play I don't know ... hitman that game has a complex mechanic namely espionage and assassination and there are different ways to proceed. Gta is a scripted game so needless to say it's far from being a 101 interactive game. We can compare it to a game: zelda! Zelda has mechanics based on exploration, thinking and problem-solving. Gta vi still nothing the game is scripted and there's nothing to say. The only thing it has left is the story let's get to the point the story isn't exceptional I see NPCs on twitter crying over the ending of gta vi because Lucia dies at the end... But excuse me but gta's narrative structure isn't deep. It's a classic story that ends badly period. It's basically Netflix's opium in fact they love doing that. In every American blockbuster or otherwise the characters die at the end, I don't know what netflix is trying to prove maybe that a brutal ending is a masterpiece but that's not the case. They did it with squid game at the end player 456 dies just to act like "look how sad and well-written my series is" squid game seasons 2 and 3 are a disaster I spent more time laughing than getting any dopamine. Then stranger things which was a good series, the ending went completely off the rails and on top of that they killed off Eleven. The creators had said they were planning a sad ending I had predicted 3 before the end of the series that Eleven was going to die following those statements and netflix's NOT AT ALL original narrative structure of trying to make a good series into an ending where the characters die. It's not the death of characters that determines whether a movie, a series or even a game has a good storyline. It's its narrative structure and the substance of the story the message it delivers to generations. Hayao Miyazaki has been doing it for years with his animated films. Eiichiro Oda too with one piece can we talk about its narrative structure which gets better with time the more time passes the more depth the story gains. Same thing recently with the release of fire emblem fortune weave which is the sequel to three houses. The game takes place in a different region from three houses so it's an original story. Well guess what not only is the story original and every branching path absolutely fascinating to discover but on top of that it follows three houses and answers questions that were never answered in that game thanks to characters connected to the games or even to the game's lore. This game has an excellent narrative structure it is complex and fascinating to discover. To finish on that note, gta vi is even devoid of that BUT it's the BEST game of all time lol 99/100 no flaws (sarcasm) I've set the record straight!

author: Zeldagamelink
quote:
Le jeu est très bien remaker que ce soit au niveau des textures ou des personnages. Ma 1ère expérience avec cette licence fut avec xenoblade chronicles 2 et je dois dire que ce titre met une claque en tout point et c'est ce qui constitue le pilier des J-Rpg.
Ce qui m'a attirer sur cette licence c'est la difficulté des combats, le scénario, l'univers et la bande son. Tout ceci agit en synergie et crée réellement quelque chose d'incroyable et c'est que j'ai retrouvé dans ce 1ère opus. C'était un departs de presque 0, comprendre toute les mécaniques de combats, comprendre la complexité de l'histoire qui je dois dire à son lot de rebondissements et tout ceci accompagné d'une d'une très belle bande son. Les personnages sont aussi attachants qie dans xenoblade chronicles 2

Ce qui m'a plu:
- Les mécaniques de combats - l'univers vaste et incroyable - l'histoire - La bande son
- La patte graphique (reprise de xenoblade chronicles 2)
- Les personnages
- Une belle remake - Le nouveau prologue Ce qui m'a déplu:
- La résolution en mode portable (540p ça pique quand même un peu les yeux pourtant le moteur n'a pas l'air gourmand)
